entries.title: The message box keeps its width at a larger Size
entries.body: At a Size of 110%, 125% or 150%, open side panels could squeeze the message box in a small window. Its hint was cut off, or it got too narrow to use. Now the side panels fold away until there is room for them beside a usable message box. They come back when the window is wider or the Size is smaller. Your panel choices stay as they were.

picture.alt: At 125% in the smallest window, with the open side panels folded away, the message box sits whole under Firstmate and shows its full hint
